QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_57

question.text: Online monitoring by the clearing corporation tracks:

answer.text: Member exposure vs margins, open positions, crystallized losses vs available margins, and futures market price movement vs spot price movement

explanation.text: The Logic: Online monitoring tracks exposure versus margins, open positions, crystallized losses versus available margins, and futures market price movement versus spot price movement (and price/volume movements not in line with past trends), generating alerts for proactive risk management. The Trap: Much more comprehensive than just volume tracking. Not about attendance or satisfaction. DPL is a separate circuit-filter concept and is not one of the online-monitoring checkpoints. Note: Real-time monitoring means breaches are detected immediately — members who approach margin limits receive automated alerts and may face position restrictions before a full breach occurs.
